label: Six-capacity knowledge-survival vector
family: XIX · Aperture v3.2-alpha embedded kernels and epistemicide methodology

record.category: XIX · Aperture v3.2-alpha embedded kernels and epistemicide methodology
record.description: Distinct capacities of retrievability, attributable provenance, interpretability, transmissibility, contestability and repairability. Complements harm measurements with the ability to continue using and defending knowledge.
record.note: The six-capacity vector belongs to the later Aperture formulation; the three original essays directly establish the five-indicator conceptual family, not this six-coordinate measurement instrument.
